svg.title: LLVMScope pass manager internals
svg.desc: Shows how passes are registered at comptime, scheduled by dependency graph, executed in parallel where safe, and how results flow to the diagnostic aggregator

g.text: Comptime pass registry (build-time, zero runtime cost)
Passes declared with comptime interface — no vtable, no heap allocation, fully inlined
